incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT - HIGH severity
incident-bot: Service: inference-hosts - host-gpu-07 (10.2.14.107) reported UNREACHABLE, kubelet NotReady, kernel panic detected. Page fired to eng-oncall. Link: https://pd.example/INC-4123

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it, taking first look.

jon (eng): ping - do we know if this is a single-node kernel panic or a wider rack issue? any other hosts flapping?

lina (infra): nothing else in that rack reported errors in the last 10m. NIC heartbeats OK for neighbors. Could be PCIe/GPU hardware on that host.

maria (oncall): trying quick kube checks:
```
kubectl get nodes | egrep "host-gpu-07|NotReady"
kubectl describe node host-gpu-07
```

maria (oncall): kubelet status shows NotReady, conditions: KubeletNotReady, NetworkUnavailable false. Last heartbeat 2m ago.

maria (oncall): SSH attempt:
```
ssh root@10.2.14.107
# connection times out on first try, now ssh connects
journalctl -k -b -1 | tail -n 200
```

maria (oncall): found kernel oops/panic in dmesg around boot - "Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt" with stack mentioning nvidia_pci and pcie_error.

lina (infra): that smells like a GPU driver/kernel interaction. Can you paste the last few lines?

maria (oncall): paste logs:
```
[    12.345678] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: RQ 0x7f timed out
[    12.345679] pcieport 1-1: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: ID 0000
[    12.345680] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[    12.345681] CPU: 1 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Not tainted 5.4.0-xyz #1
```

sam (runtime): flagging runtime impact - host-gpu-07 had 6 active containers handling production traffic for dedicated customers (pool: dedicated-west-1). We'll start routing new traffic off it.

jon (eng): cordon + drain then. Maria, can you cordon it so scheduler stops placing pods?

maria (oncall): running:
```
kubectl cordon host-gpu-07
kubectl drain host-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

maria (oncall): cordoned. Drain in progress - 4 pods evicted, 2 stuck due to local storage. Marking those for manual move.

sam (runtime): switching routing for model routes served from that dedicated pool - adding fallback mapping to model:fallback-quantized for affected customer routes. This will temporarily increase latency for a subset but avoid errors.

sam (runtime): command run:
```
api call: POST /v1/routing/update {"pool":"dedicated-west-1","route":"/models/redwood-large","fallback":"redwood-large-quant"}
```

sam (runtime): route update confirmed. New requests will go to fallback pool within ~30s.

maria (oncall): customer impact: telemetry shows ~2.1% error spike for three dedicated customers between 2026-03-14T10:32:10Z and 2026-03-14T10:38:40Z. Latency also up ~200ms for fallback traffic. I'm adding that to the PD incident.

pagerduty: Incident INC-4123 acknowledged by maria (oncall). Escalation to lina in 5m if not resolved.

lina (infra): I'm pulling the host into maintenance. We'll capture NVMe and GPU logs and open a hardware case if needed. Maria, can you snapshot /var/log/messages and upload?

maria (oncall): uploaded logs to vault: https://files.internal/logs/INC-4123/host-gpu-07-dmesg.txt

jon (eng): FYI the autoscaler didn't immediately create replacements because the node had local storage pinned. We need a quick patch to our scale-down filter to avoid this hold-up in future. Filing a follow-up ticket.

sre-lead: Confirming: mitigation steps are cordon+drain, routing fallback applied, hardware triage started. Good. Please create a post-incident ticket with timeline and customer impact numbers.

maria (oncall): created ticket RED-7564: "host-gpu-07 kernel panic -> drain & fallback routing" with attachments and timeline.

lina (infra): hardware snapshot shows firmware crash counter increment on GPU slot. I'm opening RMA with vendor, attaching logs.

sam (runtime): monitoring shows error rate returning to baseline after route switch. Rolling back fallback not advisable until host is healthy. I'll keep the fallback live for 2h and then re-evaluate.

maria (oncall): handing off to jon for overnight watch. I need to go offline in 10. Jon, you have PD responsibility and the ticket.

jon (eng): taking handoff. Acknowledged. I'll watch metrics and coordinate with infra for RMA progress. Setting status to steppable.

maria (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: I'll drop a short blameless note in #incidents after a sync with infra.

jon (eng): quick action items for follow-up:
- infra: RMA and firmware analysis (lina)
- runtime: make fallback route automation into a runbook (sam)
- eng: autoscaler filter update (jon)
- ops: customer comms draft for affected customers (sre-lead)

sre-lead: good. I'll draft comms and queue for review. Thanks everyone.

maria (oncall): last check-in before handoff: metrics stable, no further panics reported.

jon (eng): received handoff. closing the PD page for now but leaving incident open until RMA complete.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-4123 status changed to "acknowledged -> in progress" by jon (eng).

jon (eng): logging final note here: node host-gpu-07 kernel panic likely triggered by GPU firmware/driver interaction causing PCIe AER. Triage ongoing with vendor. Handoff complete.

maria (oncall): thanks all. :heart:
